description:
The populated place nearest to a point, by great-circle distance over the same list as /geo/search, and the IANA zone of the point itself (which near a border can differ from the place's). Works across the antimeridian and at the poles. At sea `timezone` is the nautical hour band (`Etc/GMT+2`, whose sign is inverted by POSIX convention) and `nautical` is true; `place.distanceKm` says how far the nearest place is, so a point in open water is not mistaken for a town. `featureCode` PPLX marks a section of a city rather than a city.

[Group: Astro-Geography]
[Endpoint: GET /v1/geo/reverse]
[Required: lat, lon]
[Cost: 5 credits (Tier ½)]

lang.description: Language for the place, region and country names.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, north positive.

lon.description: Longitude in decimal degrees, east positive.
